Theme

New agendas and tools

Almost every theme the Council now treats as routine arrived after 1990, most between 1999 and 2018. Each row is the landmark resolution where the idea is set out as Council business. The last column counts resolutions whose text uses the term.

The Council started as a body that refereed wars between states. It is now a body that legislates on how wars are fought inside states, and on threats that are not wars at all.
